When comparing two multimodal sequences, if both have `LLAMA_TOKEN_NULL` at the same position, the code looks up the associated media chunks and compares their IDs and token counts — only if those match does it consider the position a match and skips ahead past the media tokens. The distinction is that multimodal sequences can have variable-length media token blocks, so a simple token-by-token comparison wouldn't work across different renderings of the same media.
